azienda.title: Our History
azienda.subtitle: For over 40 years, the benchmark for absolute quality and reliability in textile sampling.
azienda.supplyText: From concept to finished product. We handle Sewing, Bookbinding, Screen Printing, Hot Stamping, Digital Printing, and in-house graphic bureau.
paragraphs_top: With over 40 years of experience, Campionari Sara Group is a benchmark in the textile sampling industry. Our philosophy is built on three essential pillars: absolute quality, constant reliability, and rigorous punctuality in every delivery.

We take pride in managing the entire production chain in-house. From sewing and bookbinding to screen printing, from hot stamping to PVC welding, all the way to digital printing and our dedicated graphic department, every stage is monitored to ensure excellence.
paragraphs_bottom: This integrated structure allows us to respond with extreme flexibility to market demands, handling both small batches and large production volumes with the same care, always through tailored solutions designed to best showcase every material.

You can always count on the support of dedicated professionals, ready to accompany you at every stage of your project and identify precise solutions for every need. Behind this service is a solid and highly qualified team: skilled workers with many years of experience, textile specialists, bookbinders, screen printers, graphic designers and communication experts, all working in synergy to turn every request into a concrete result, crafted in every detail.
For us, every sample book is not simply a product, but a strategic tool capable of best expressing the identity and value of the brand it represents.

steps.title: 1. Consultation & Prototyping
steps.text: We analyze your needs and create faithful prototypes to evaluate materials and finishes before production.

steps.text: We handle every phase internally: cutting, printing, assembly, and packaging, ensuring total control over quality.
